title: Smart Home Voice Command Router (3 Fields)
description: Reduces a free-text transcribed home automation request to three decisions: whether it holds more than one command, which area it targets, and which verb it invokes.
context: turn on the lights in front of the house

multiple_commands.description: Whether the request contains more than one distinct command

command_area.description: Area of the home the command concerns

command_domain.description: Domain of the command (e.g., lighting, climate, switch)
